name: Default
shortDescription: Scheduled backups for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and MongoDB with encryption, retention policies, remote storage and notifications.

alerts.message: The first account that signs up administers the instance. Create it right after deployment, then disable sign-ups in the settings if the instance is public.
Backups are encrypted with the key stored in /databasus-data/secret.key. Copy it somewhere safe: without it, encrypted backups cannot be restored on a new instance.
